title: de-wordpress-fevm-lighthouse
tagline: With SellX3, like WordPress but in Web3, anyone can build their own small business in Web3 with some clicks and even with the freedom to customize their whole web3 DApp!
description:
With SellX3, anyone can build their own small business in Web3 with some clicks and even with the freedom to customize their whole web3 DApp!

Everything you need to start a web3 business
SellX3 comes with batteries included. It takes the best parts of state-of-the-art tools and adds its own innovations.

It will run as like WordPress, but a Web3 DAO. 
It will have the theme && plugin hook later.
Now we just demo the func that user can create a new blog/shop/site and sell/nft-gating with lighthouse SDK and combine with the FEVM data deal logic that keep the De-WordPress content persist on IPFS network forever.
how_its_made:
VitePress, EthersJs, IPFS, nft.storage, FEVM, lighthouse SDK, All with web3 tech to build the platform! Also, it has an ERC1155 NFT as the data center! Put your creation on to blockchain with only one Button to Click.

## sponsor technology: lighthouse && FEVM
The lighthouse SDK is just really great We use it to make our token gating logic, and bloggers can use it to gate their new articles/posts, so readers can mint the blogger's NFT as payment to pay for the great content.
 Also, we use the FEVM Actor which while bloggers create new articles, pay a $FIL fee for it. Later the Storage Provider can activate the deal then after the store expired,  SP can call the claim entry to get the bounty.

NFT as a membership card
Every buidler owns an ERC1155 NFT that web3 citizens can mint NFT as payment.

A guide page that helps new users to create their shop/site/blog/novel easily.
Users can create new blog posts on their De-WordPress site and have the ability to customize their theme/style/func as the whole platform is open-source.
In the near future, we will develop the theme and plugin module work like WordPress does, so our application can involve more developers to join in and create their themes and plugins to power up the De-WordPress!
